title: www prefix should be supported on streamlit community cloud apps
body:
### Checklist

- [X] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar feature requests.
- [X] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue.

### Summary

Recently, a user of mine tried to visit www.[myapp].streamlit.app instead of [myapp].streamlit.app, and got a certificate error.

### Why?

In my opinion the optional www prefix, although a stupid relic of the past, should be supported if possible, because some tools (and, presumably, people) still put it in automatically.

### How?

www.whatever.streamlit.app should redirect you (or something like that) to whatever.streamlit.app. The certificate will also need to be adjusted.

### Additional Context

_No response_
